newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tobishima restructuring making progress - Fuji Bank.
newsitem.headline: Tobishima restructuring making progress - Fuji Bank.

text.p: Fuji Bank Ltd, the main creditor bank for Tobishima Corp, said on Friday that a restructuring programme for the construction company was making progress.
The bank also said in a statement that market rumours that Tobishima faced financial difficulties were groundless.
Fuji Bank said it "actively" supported a restructuring plan worked out by Tobishima, adding that it was sure other creditors would also agree to the plan.

Debt-ridden Tobishima said in October it had drawn up a restructuring plan to try to solve its financial difficulties. It said it would ask its creditors to reduce their claims against it for debts owed by its group companies to 100 billion yen from about 740 billion yen.

Earlier on Friday, Tobishima denied market talk that it had applied for court protection from its creditors. The denial was in a statement issued by the construction company after a sharp fall in its share price.
Tobishima has said it fell into financial difficulties due to extending loans for property-related business.
